findings.report:
## 1. Pilot a two-prompt transfer probe for mining usefulness (context-quality, not infra)

One repeatable 30-minute transfer probe that teaches context engineering: whether a one-paragraph operational-vs-context hint changes mining usefulness on the original prompt and transfers to a reworded prompt.

**Why now:** Plumbing is proven (17 tests pass, gap handling typed) but quality is unmeasured in-app; goal's near-term question is whether a fresh agent suggests work Remi would consider without reconstructing conversation. Smallest leverage is a human-scored A/B + transfer sample, not more infrastructure.

**Evidence**
- Goal defines usefulness as proposal Remi would consider and completed-run != useful proposal: factory/context/goal.md L13,L17; missing-source rule L25.
- WIP says baseline same-prompt + transfer complete, scores withheld, do not recreate runner/inventory/replay: factory/context/work-in-progress.md L7-L13; artifacts in factory/mining/ excluded.
- Project map: no task-mining quality evaluation in deployed app: factory/context/project-map.md L17; GitHub+Vercel reads required, failed reads are gaps L21.
- Operational plumbing already green locally: pnpm --filter @jira-clone/factory test exit 0, 17/17 pass (mining-output, vercel-context, report) — proves display/gap handling, not proposal quality.
- Live GitHub complete-empty: issues [] + pulls [] captured 2026-09-12T11:49:23Z for software-factory-workshop/jira-clone; Vercel project+deployments reads for cockpit+jira all ConnectionAuthorizationFailedError — deployed revision unproven.

**Existing work:** Builds on excluded fx calibration runner (factory/mining/) and deployed native-Eve station (apps/factory/agent/agent.ts, tools/record_findings.ts, app/components/MiningRun.vue, app/utils/mining-output.ts); respects WIP ban on rebuilding fx wrapper and does not duplicate same-prompt replay. Extends tested gap handling (apps/factory/agent/lib/vercel-context.ts L55-56, L18-28) from plumbing to quality.

**Scope**
- Add one experiment record file (e.g. docs/mining-usefulness-probe.md or factory/reflections/ candidate) with prompts, rubric, raw-output links, and score table
- Run two bounded investigations on the pinned tree only; no product code, no issue publication, no rule activation, no Vercel/GitHub writes

**Acceptance criteria**
- Reuses pinned snapshot revision b81899e5d9ecd49b04840c649af0d63e0bbc8188 and records exact prompts, raw outputs, revision, timestamps, and human scorer.
- Runs exactly two cheap Muse/native-Eve probes: (A) baseline mining prompt, (B) same goal with differently worded focus explicitly asking to separate operational infrastructure (builds, plumbing, auth wiring) from context quality (goal/map/reflection wording) — no new runner, inventory, or infra code.
- Scores each run on 5 binary checks: cites observed file/line, checks empty GitHub inventories + work-in-progress.md, cites Vercel revision or names gap, distinguishes fixture/model assertion from verified run, names bounded outcome + how to tell it helped.
- Publishes one experiment record with before/after + transfer table and conclusion (improved/regressed/inconclusive/environment-blocked) per docs/factory-growth-experiment.md L59-73; makes no factory-rule or instruction change.

**Uncertainties**
- Remi acceptance of any proposal still pending — human score is proxy, not owner approval.
- Model variation vs context effect: single replay cannot prove significance; needs repeat only if signal appears.
- Vercel gap persists in sandbox; transfer claim limited to repo+GitHub reasoning until hosted auth verified.

## Reflection

**helpfulContext**
- factory/context/goal.md current experiment + usefulness definition + evidence taxonomy
- factory/context/work-in-progress.md calibration-complete status and fx-wrapper ban
- factory/context/project-map.md navigation + no-quality-eval note + gap semantics
- factory/task-mining-station.md native-Eve contract + cost/limits + preflight idea
- packages/project-context/src/index.ts stages/references/fixtures vs jira-reference.json observations
- apps/factory/app/utils/mining-output.ts display-boundary + apps/factory/agent/lib/vercel-context.ts scoping/gap logic
- Live empty issues/pulls receipts and Vercel auth-failure messages distinguishing missing access from empty backlog

**missingContext**
- Held-out review criteria and raw factory/mining/ runs intentionally excluded from snapshot — treated as unavailable for inspection per map, not as proof of no work.
- Deployed cockpit/jira revisions and build/runtime logs unavailable due to Vercel user-auth gap — prevents snapshot-vs-deployed comparison.

**contradictions**
- No direct contradiction: empty GitHub inventories plus active WIP is expected per work-in-progress.md (work can be active without an issue).
- Apparent staleness: 2026-09-12-context-review.md L9 says UI stage strings describe earlier request-to-work-order roadmap, but packages/project-context/src/index.ts L6-49 now lists Mine/Learn/Make/Check/Improve — suggests fix landed since reflection; needs dated recheck, not a new stage-string proposal.

**suggestedImprovements**
- Add one line to project-map.md evidence table: operational infrastructure (typecheck/test/build, sandbox, MCP plumbing) vs context quality (goal/map/reflection wording) with pointer to this probe.
- Render the 5-point usefulness checklist alongside MiningRun evidence gaps so reviewers judge relevance, not just completeness.
- Document Vercel user-auth preflight for mining so future runs distinguish auth-gap from empty deployments without retrying four failing reads.

## Context gaps

- Vercel project/deployment evidence for both cockpit (prj_ZXLHFUJhgo5EdvSf1IstOMn0ft0A) and jira (prj_C3sDKTOQIOqpIpNO9w7bqcWYkwp4) in team team_Ljrc7ENgQWsCySwCwijvA0zy unavailable in this sandbox: vercel_read for project and deployments on both projects returned ConnectionAuthorizationFailedError (user-scoped connection fell back to local-dev access, requires Vercel user auth / linked CLI OIDC). Deployed revision vs working snapshot b81899e5d9ecd49b04840c649af0d63e0bbc8188 therefore unresolved.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for cockpit.
- Missing Vercel project or deployment evidence for Jira.
